newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Eleven Palestinians swept away in West Bank flood.
newsitem.headline: Eleven Palestinians swept away in West Bank flood.

text.p: Eleven Palestinians were swept away in a flood near the West Bank town of Qalqilya, witnesses and the Israeli army said on Sunday.
"The Israeli army with help from rescue units is searching for Arab residents who were swept away with their vehicle in a flood south of Qalqilya," an army spokesman said.

Witnesses said a mini-van filled with Palestinian workers crashed into a flooded valley on Saturday night after a bridge collapsed. They said two managed to free themselves from the raging torrent and that 11 swept away with the vehicle were feared dead.
The army said it was coordinating search efforts with Palestinian police. The mini-van was swept away in a West Bank area under Israeli security control and Palestinian civilian jurisdiction.
